verdict.rationale: Undermind's own docs describe background monitoring: it watches saved topics and notifies users when relevant papers are published, with role-aware alerts on enterprise plans. That is a recurring autonomous behavior, but it is limited to paper alerts rather than user-configurable automations. Its deep literature review runs autonomously but is a one-off, user-triggered action, not a recurring background job. Missing for 10: general user-defined automation or workflow setup, scheduling controls, any trigger or action configuration beyond topic alerts, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the alerting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Get notified whenever relevant papers are published.
Role-aware alerts: Monitors saved topics and sends concise updates tailored to each teammate’s role and active projects.
